names: the #1039 follow-up: the balance-sheet debt total refuses an 'indebtedness' row beside its long-term debt row (Perrigo's 'Current indebtedness 36.6') and no longer refuses on an 'Accrued interest on notes' row (interest, not principal), and a current portion the debt note subtracts under its other wordings (no parentheses, a bare 'Less: Current maturities', a lettered footnote, 'included in accrued expenses'), when what it subtracts is debt — never a lease, deferred revenue, interest or a tax, and never a row's own ', less current maturities'; no wall in the cached corpus moves
